name: Steakhouse USDC V2
oneLiner: steakUSDC is Steakhouse's curated Morpho ERC-4626 lending vault over USDC; share price accrues borrower interest with FIFO withdrawal queue on Morpho liquidity.
collateral: USDC deposited into a Steakhouse-curated Morpho vault that allocates across Morpho lending markets backed by blue-chip crypto and real-world asset collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626-style Morpho vault shares appreciate against USDC as borrower interest accrues; withdrawals redeem vault shares for available USDC liquidity or wait for Morpho market liquidity to return

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: steakUSDC is an immutable, deposit-only MetaMorpho ERC-4626 vault share over USDC; it does not create discretionary base-asset supply.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.
